identity.name: Elegance Omiwatari
identity.one_liner: The 38.5mm Spring Drive dress watch in 18k yellow gold with the Omiwatari dial — a horizontal texture named for the trails said to be left by a god crossing a frozen lake in Japanese folklore.

narrative.story: The SBGY007 is the high-end of the Grand Seiko Elegance line: 18k yellow gold, the 9R31 Spring Drive caliber (an 8L-loosely-related manual-wind movement with a power-reserve indicator and an off-centre 9:00 dial), and a textured dial inspired by Omiwatari — the ice ridges said to be left by a god crossing Lake Suwa in winter. The 38.5mm case is the smallest Spring Drive dress watch Grand Seiko makes, and the 9R31 is the thinnest Spring Drive at 9.2mm. The SBGY007 is the most-cited luxury-tier Grand Seiko of the 2020s.
